summary: After generation, these claims were checked again in a separate pass outside the agent, by fetching each provider's page directly on 3 November 2026 and comparing the text. This sample covers the claims a developer would plan around. It isn't every claim in every guide. 12 held up or got corrected here, 2 could not be verified.

entries.claim: New apps get one Development Mode Client ID per developer
entries.note: The agent relied on the February 2026 post and missed a July 2026 update that raised the limit to 25 Client IDs sharing one quota. Fixed in the guide, and the agent now has to look for newer changelogs.

entries.claim: The six-week review figure was labelled uncertain, because the agent couldn't read the page
entries.note: The quota modes page states it directly: review can take up to six weeks. Relabelled as sourced.

entries.claim: Extended Quota needs a registered business and at least 250k monthly active users
entries.note: Stated on the quota modes page.

entries.claim: Development Mode requires Premium and allows up to five authorized users per Client ID
Marketplace review: up to 10 business days, then up to 10 weeks for new submissions, after 10 active workspace installs
entries.note: All three figures are in the review guide.

entries.claim: Non-Marketplace apps are limited to 1 request a minute and 15 objects on conversations.history
entries.note: Stated in Slack's May 2025 changelog entry.

entries.claim: Plans allow 5, 50, 1,000 and 10,000 connections at no charge, $35, $245 and $1,445 AUD a month
Testing mode allows up to 100 test users, and their authorizations expire after seven days
entries.note: Stated in Google's OAuth app audience help page.

entries.claim: Restricted scopes need an annual third-party security assessment, and verification can take several weeks
entries.note: Stated by Google. Google gives no exact range, so the guide's 2-8 weeks is an estimate and stays labelled uncertain.

entries.claim: Marketplace submissions get a reply within 5-10 business days
The distribution method can't be changed once selected
Repeated review failures can pause an app in a cooldown
entries.note: Stated on the review submission page.

entries.claim: App Store review takes about 2-5 weeks
entries.note: The review page publishes no turnaround time, so this rests on developer forum reports and stays labelled uncertain.

entries.claim: The logged-in setup flows and real approval outcomes
entries.note: No provider accounts were created and no app was submitted for review. Steps come from documentation, and the live probes only show what an anonymous visitor sees.
